# Akka Documentation

> Akka has one offering: the Akka Agentic AI Platform, which provides resilience and
> scalability for the agentic systems you build with it. Its four solutions are Akka SDK, Akka
> Specify, Akka Verify and Akka Optimize. They share one definition of an AI system, one
> runtime, one ledger and one governance model.

- Akka SDK is the component model for building agentic systems.
- Akka Specify is spec-driven development tooling that builds an agentic system from
  plain-language specifications and checks every change against them.
- Akka Verify is runtime-native evaluation, enforcement, evidence and governance for agents
  built on Akka or elsewhere.
- Akka Optimize routes traffic to the best open-weight model and trains smaller ones on your data.

Every system built with Akka runs on the Akka runtime, operated by you or by Akka Automated
Operations. The documentation sections are organized by task; the About Akka pages map each solution to
the sections that document it. Akka (formerly Lightbend) is distinct from the open-source Akka
actor library for the JVM, which is its lineage.

Personas: Builders (Application Developers, AI/ML Engineers, Product Managers), Operators
(Platform Engineers, SREs), Governance & Oversight (Compliance Analysts, InfoSec, FinOps).

## About Akka

- [About Akka](https://doc.akka.io/about-akka.html.md): The Akka Agentic AI Platform, its four solutions, and where each is documented
- [How the solutions work together](https://doc.akka.io/about/how-it-fits.html.md): What the four solutions share, and one agent followed from specification to a trained model
- [Akka SDK](https://doc.akka.io/about/akka-sdk.html.md): The component model: agents, workflows, entities, views, endpoints, timers and consumers
- [Akka Specify](https://doc.akka.io/about/akka-specify.html.md): Spec-driven development tooling: specifications, exit conditions and conformance
- [Akka Verify](https://doc.akka.io/about/akka-verify.html.md): Evaluation, the five control mechanisms, governance and the ledger
- [Akka Optimize](https://doc.akka.io/about/akka-optimize.html.md): Model routing, serving, training and spend
- [How Akka runs](https://doc.akka.io/about/how-akka-runs.html.md): The runtime, deployment options, and Akka Automated Operations
- [Resources](https://doc.akka.io/resources.html.md): Blogs, demos, webinars, foundational works, training, and community

## Getting Started

- [Getting started](https://doc.akka.io/getting-started/index.html.md): Install the Akka plugin, set up your environment, and run your first specification
- [Set up your environment](https://doc.akka.io/getting-started/set-up-env.html.md): Four self-contained setup paths — install using your AI harness, manually set up your AI harness, manually set up your environment, or use a container
- [Spec-first hello agent](https://doc.akka.io/getting-started/spec-your-first-agent.html.md): Build your first agent with spec-driven development
- [Code-first hello agent](https://doc.akka.io/getting-started/author-your-first-service.html.md): Build the same agent by hand in Java
- [Multi-agent tutorial](https://doc.akka.io/getting-started/planner-agent/index.html.md): Orchestrate multiple agents with a workflow
- [RAG chat tutorial](https://doc.akka.io/getting-started/ask-akka-agent/index.html.md): Build a retrieval-augmented chat agent
- [Shopping cart tutorial](https://doc.akka.io/getting-started/shopping-cart/index.html.md): Build an event-sourced service with entities and views
- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)](https://doc.akka.io/getting-started/ask-akka-agent/rag.html.md): Semantic search on vector databases to enrich AI model requests
- [CLI installation](https://doc.akka.io/getting-started/install-cli.html.md): Install the Akka CLI
- [Log in to a remote environment](https://doc.akka.io/getting-started/log-in.html.md): Log in to deploy to or manage a remote Akka environment

## Building with AI

- [Spec-Driven Development](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/spec-driven-development.html.md): The primary development approach: build from plain-language specifications, checked on every change
- [Enforced mode](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/enforced-mode.html.md): Require exit conditions and conformance checks before changes merge
- [À la carte mode](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/a-la-carte-mode.html.md): Choose which development commands and checks to run
- [Specify command reference](https://doc.akka.io/reference/specify/index.html.md): Commands for specifications, planning, implementation, inspection, and release
- [Using an AI coding assistant](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/ai-coding-assistant.html.md): Enable AI assistants to use the Akka CLI natively

## SDK Components

- [Components overview](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/components/index.html.md): Akka's core building blocks, with a decision guide for choosing between them and when not to use each
- [Agents](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/agents.html.md): AI model-backed components with session memory and multi-agent collaboration
- [Autonomous Agents](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/autonomous-agents.html.md): Durable model-driven processes with typed tasks and multi-agent coordination
- [Workflows](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/workflows.html.md): Long-running, multi-step business processes with compensation
- [Event Sourced Entities](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/event-sourced-entities.html.md): State persistence via immutable event log
- [Key Value Entities](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/key-value-entities.html.md): State persistence via full-state snapshots
- [Views](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/views.html.md): Read-optimized projections across entities
- [HTTP Endpoints](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/http-endpoints.html.md): REST APIs with JSON, OpenAPI, server-sent events, and WebSocket support, plus serving web application assets
- [Web applications](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/web-applications.html.md): Serve a web application from a service — single-page application assets, static files, or generated HTML — alongside the API it calls, on your own domain with TLS
- [gRPC Endpoints](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/grpc-endpoints.html.md): High-performance APIs with gRPC
- [MCP Endpoints](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/mcp-endpoints.html.md): Expose tools, resources, and prompt templates to MCP clients
- [Consumers](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/consuming-producing.html.md): Stream-based event consumption and production
- [Timed Actions](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/timed-actions.html.md): Scheduled and delayed calls

## Autonomous Agents

- [Autonomous agent coordination patterns](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/autonomous-agents/coordination.html.md): Sequential, delegative, collaborative, and emergent patterns for multi-agent systems
- [Autonomous agent coordination capabilities](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/autonomous-agents/capabilities.html.md): Delegation, handoff, teams, moderation, external input, and capability composition

- [Testing autonomous agents](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/autonomous-agents/testing.html.md): Mocking with `TestModelProvider` and `AutonomousAgentTools` helpers

## Testing

- [Testing overview](https://doc.akka.io/testing/index.html.md): Three kinds of testing — unit, integration, evaluation
- [Unit testing](https://doc.akka.io/testing/unit.html.md): Exercise one component at a time with per-component TestKits
- [Integration testing](https://doc.akka.io/testing/integration.html.md): Exercise multiple components together against an in-process runtime
- [Evaluation](https://doc.akka.io/testing/evaluation/index.html.md): Run an agent through evaluation cases in a TestKit test and check replies and traced tool calls with built-in evaluators, a judge and a gate
- [Evaluation getting started](https://doc.akka.io/testing/evaluation/getting-started.html.md): An agent with two tools, a test class with a mocked model, one case, then a gated batch
- [Evaluation cases and evaluators](https://doc.akka.io/testing/evaluation/eval-cases.html.md): `EvalCase` parts and every built-in evaluator with its report name and when it is inconclusive
- [Model judges](https://doc.akka.io/testing/evaluation/judges.html.md): `Judge.modelBased`, `shouldSatisfy` and `shouldScoreAtLeast`, the judge prompt, gating on the judge pass rate
- [Gates and reports](https://doc.akka.io/testing/evaluation/gates-and-reports.html.md): Gate factories, reading an `EvalReport` and a failed case
- [Replaying recorded interactions](https://doc.akka.io/testing/evaluation/replay.html.md): `EvalCaseParser`, the JSONL format, `ToolBindings` and budgets from recorded spend

## Inference

- [Inference](https://doc.akka.io/inference/index.html.md): Running AI models, and how an inference call differs from a function call
- [Serving your first model](https://doc.akka.io/inference/serving/getting-started.html.md): A tutorial that deploys a model in an Akka region and calls it
- [Allocating hardware to models](https://doc.akka.io/inference/serving/allocating-hardware.html.md): The accelerator pools a region offers, and claiming whole devices from a pool
- [Deploying models](https://doc.akka.io/inference/serving/deploying-models.html.md): Declaring a model, tuning the engine, applying the descriptor, and removing what it created
- [Exposing and calling models](https://doc.akka.io/inference/serving/exposing-and-calling-models.html.md): Model endpoints, project routes, per-client API keys, and calling the OpenAI-compatible endpoint
- [Routing requests to models](https://doc.akka.io/inference/routing.html.md): Routing on request attributes and on request meaning, use cases, manifests, and shifting traffic
- [Capture and grading](https://doc.akka.io/inference/capture-and-grading.html.md): Capture processing, discovered use cases, grading, and eligibility for specialization
- [Understanding inference costs](https://doc.akka.io/inference/spend.html.md): Pricing rules, unpriced traffic, token lower bounds, reporting completeness, and attribution

- [Tracking inference spend](https://doc.akka.io/inference/tracking-spend.html.md): Publishing a versioned pricing catalog, and reading what model traffic in a period consumed and cost

## Concepts

- [Platform model](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/platform-model.html.md): Organizations, projects, services, components, regions and routes, and the planes that run them
- [Anatomy of a request](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/request-lifecycle.html.md): One agent request traced from the endpoint to the ledger record and the evaluation that follow it
- [Distributed systems principles](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/distributed-systems.html.md): Isolated state, asynchronous messages, failure handling and location transparency
- [Components and effects](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/components.html.md): The building blocks of a service and the effects their methods return
- [State and read models](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/state-model.html.md): Entity persistence, query projections, and consistency boundaries
- [Durable execution](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/durable-execution.html.md): Workflows that survive failures, with retries, timeouts, compensation and waits for a person
- [Events and streaming](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/delivery-guarantees.html.md): At-least-once delivery, duplicate handling, back-pressure, and live streams
- [Agents](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/ai-agents.html.md): Request-based and Autonomous Agents, models, prompts and context
- [Memory and context](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/agent-memory.html.md): Session memory, compaction, long-term memory and context management
- [Tools and agent protocols](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/tools-and-protocols.html.md): Function tools, MCP and A2A
- [Multi-agent coordination](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/ai-orchestration-patterns.html.md): Supervisors, context boundaries, and coordination patterns
- [Specifications and conformance](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/spec-driven-development.html.md): Specifications, project rules, exit conditions, and acceptance checks
- [Governance and the runtime](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/governance-and-the-runtime.html.md): Why governance runs in the runtime, control ids and compliance
- [Controls](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/controls.html.md): Guardrails, sanitizers, evals, human decisions and gates, verdicts and halt
- [Evaluation](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/evaluation.html.md): Test, batch, replay and live evaluation, and how results map across sections
- [From risk to controls](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/risk-to-controls.html.md): Risk envelope, risk survey, signed bundles and controls in force
- [The ledger and evidence](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/evidence.html.md): Records, identity and authority, evidence packs and retention
- [Models and inference](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/models.html.md): Model interactions, routing, hosted providers, and served models
- [Model improvement and cost](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/model-training.html.md): Capture, grading, training, promotion, and cost trade-offs
- [The runtime](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/runtime.html.md): Clustering, sharding, passivation and recovery from events
- [Deployment and operations](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/deployment-model.html.md): Deployment options, responsibility boundaries, and platform operations
- [Multi-region operations](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/multi-region.html.md): Replicated reads, primary regions and asynchronous replication
- [Availability and recovery](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/availability.html.md): Zones, regions, failover, backup and moving between environments
- [Security and identity](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/security-and-identity.html.md): Workload identity, mutual TLS, access control and multi-tenancy
- [Observability](https://doc.akka.io/concepts/observability.html.md): Logs, metrics and traces, and how they differ from the ledger
- [Architecture model](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/architecture-model.html.md): How an Akka project is structured across api, application, and domain layers
- [Design considerations](https://doc.akka.io/sdk/dev-best-practices.html.md): Reactive principles, domain-driven design, service sizing, and deduplication
